competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix: One-click Facebook Marketplace posting that works—no video production, no 9 platforms to manage, no learning curve. Chrome extension simplicity for dealers who want to sell faster, not juggle more tools.

competitor_signals.signal: Published comparison page (July 2026) positioning as transparent pricing alternative to Shiftly (AutoLister at $99/mo vs Shiftly ~$149/mo with 3-month commitment); claims 429+ active dealers and multi-platform reach (Marketplace, Instagram, TikTok); emphasizes month-to-month flexibility
